title: 第530章 奇怪的龙皓晨
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

考拉国天幕：

【不是，我都要急死了，还想说为什么芮娜娜不去捉羊，没想到是完全忘记了！】

【芮娜娜真是太惨了，虽然还有大部分国家都忘记了，但只有她一个讲出了发现的漏洞。】

【唉，这样的天选者就不该死，明明什么错都没有。】

【虽然她前面吃脖子的时候我就发现了不正常，但没想到羊村村民规则也没有写，待在这些羊的家里会不想走，然后忘记要做的事啊！】

【龙国的林远跑了就算了，骑士国的龙皓晨是什么情况啊，为啥他也可以跑啊？】

【可恶啊，现在就剩下了三个国家，一个骑士国、一个龙国、一个丑国了。】

【啊，大部分国家的天选者都没有度过这一关吗？】

【是的......唉.....不可能再复制熊出怪谈游戏的生存率了！】

【是啊，从这次开始有筛选副本就应该看出来的，可惜......】

骑士国天幕。

骑士国天选者龙皓晨，在得到骑士国的提示后，也和沸羊羊一起回到了羊村。

但熟悉龙皓晨的人突然发现，这家伙似乎变了。

从昨天红太狼将他救回去醒来后，龙皓晨的眼神和以前都不一样了。

他甚至......出现了短暂的震惊和恐慌。

在那之后，他对着面前的空气开心地笑了起来。

还说了几句众人听不懂的话：

“这怪谈我也不了解啊，也不是动漫啊？”

“就是青山墓地出现的新住户好像是小说里的......等等，这是什么？！”

“我就知道穿越者不会这么惨的！”

从那之后，龙皓晨就开始不对劲起来。

他做的每一件事，都开始不符合以前的作风。

比如说......一晚上给红太狼洗了一百次脚，一早上给红太狼做了一百份饭......以及，答应帮沸羊羊给美羊羊捶一百次背。

骑士国怪谈指挥中心一度以为龙皓晨出现了神经错乱。

但每一步他都险象环生后活了下来，并未在怪谈游戏里死去。

就像到了羊村，他给美羊羊捶了一百次背后，坐在地上开心地笑了。

随即，他手里变出了一把枪。

没人知道龙皓晨是怎么带进怪谈游戏的，但那把枪和海绵宝宝给林远的定身美味蟹黄堡一样，可以让美羊羊处于麻痹状态，并且发不了声。

在那之后，龙皓晨扛着美羊羊，拖着正巧碰到的沸羊羊返回了狼堡。

当然在出羊村前，慢羊羊来阻止他了。

不过那把枪的威力很强大，仅仅一枪，慢羊羊也麻痹到无力阻拦。

Koala Kingdom Sky Screen:

[No, I was so anxious that I wanted to say why Rui Nana didn’t catch the sheep, but I didn’t expect that I had completely forgotten about it!】

[Rui Nana is so miserable. Although most countries have forgotten it, she was the only one to tell about the loopholes she discovered.】

[Alas, such a chosen one does not deserve to die. He obviously did nothing wrong.】

[Although I noticed something was wrong when she ate the neck earlier, I didn’t expect that the rules of the sheep villagers were not written. If you stay in the home of these sheep, you will not want to leave, and then forget what you have to do!】

[Forget it if Lin Yuan from the Dragon Kingdom runs away, what is the situation with Long Haochen from the Knight Kingdom? Why can he run away too?】

[Damn it, there are only three countries left now, a knight country, a dragon country, and an ugly country.】

[Ah, haven’t the chosen ones in most countries passed this level?】

[Yes...sigh...it's impossible to replicate the survival rate of the Bear Adventure Game!】

[Yes, you should have been able to tell when there were screening copies from now on, but it’s a pity...]

The sky of the Kingdom of Knights.

Long Haochen, the Chosen One of the Knight Kingdom, also returned to Yangcun with Boiling Sheep after receiving the reminder from the Knight Kingdom.

But those who were familiar with Long Haochen suddenly discovered that this guy seemed to have changed.

Ever since Red Wolf rescued him and woke up yesterday, Long Haochen's eyes were different from before.

He even... had a brief moment of shock and panic.

After that, he laughed happily into the air in front of him.

He also said a few words that no one could understand:

"I don't understand this weird story either, isn't it an anime?"

"The new residents who appeared in Qingshan Cemetery seem to be from novels...wait, what is this?!"

"I knew the time traveler wouldn't be so miserable!"

From then on, things started to go wrong with Long Haochen.

Everything he did began to be inconsistent with his previous style.

For example... I washed Red Wolf's feet a hundred times in one night, cooked a hundred meals for Red Wolf in the morning... and promised to help Boiling Sheep and beat Beautiful Sheep's back a hundred times.

The Command Center of Knight Country Ghost Story once thought that Long Haochen had gone insane.

But he survived every step of the way and did not die in the ghost story game.

Just like when he arrived in Yangcun, he slapped Meiyangyang on the back a hundred times and sat on the ground laughing happily.

Immediately, a gun appeared in his hand.

No one knows how Long Haochen brought it into the Guaitan game, but that gun is the same as the delicious Krabby Patty that SpongeBob gave Lin Yuan. It can paralyze the beautiful sheep and make them unable to make a sound.

After that, Long Haochen carried the beautiful sheep and dragged the boiling sheep back to Wolf Castle.

Of course, before leaving Yangcun, Manyangyang came to stop him.

However, the power of that gun was very powerful. With just one shot, Manchu Yangyang was too paralyzed to stop him.
